inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Saturn in Aries in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: 5 Steps to Map Saturn in Aries in Your Chart
inline.titleZh: 在星盘中解读牧羊座土星的5个步骤
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for mapping the Saturn in Aries transit in your natal chart
inline.altZh: 在本命盘中解读牧羊座土星过境的五步流程

items.subEn: Locate the house Aries rules in your natal chart — that domain carries Saturn's structural demand 2026–2028
items.subZh: 在本命盘中找到白羊座所在宫位，该领域将承受2026至2028年的土星结构压力

items.nameEn: Read the House, Not the Headline
items.subEn: 10th house = career and public role; 7th house = partnership — each house domain defines the structure needed
items.subZh: 第十宫代表事业与公众形象，第七宫代表伴侣关系——宫位领域决定所需的结构

items.nameZh: 确认是否叠加土星回归
items.subEn: Confirm your natal Saturn sign first — only those born with natal Saturn in Aries get a Return overlaid on this transit
items.subZh: 先确认本命土星星座——只有本命土星在白羊座的人才会同时经历土星回归

items.subEn: Saturn previewed Aries in 2025, retreated to Pisces, then re-entered Feb 2026 — treat the early taste as rehearsal
items.subZh: 土星于2025年预览白羊座后退回双鱼座，2026年2月再次入驻——将早期感受视为预演

items.nameZh: 将压力转化为建设行动
items.subEn: Name one concrete structure to construct in that house — Saturn rewards deliberate effort over reactive starts
items.subZh: 在该宫位命名一件具体要建立的事——土星奖励有意识的努力而非冲动行事

inline.titleEn: 4 Common Misreadings of Saturn in Aries
inline.titleZh: 关于牧羊座土星的4个常见误读
inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of the Saturn in Aries transit corrected
inline.altZh: 牧羊座土星过境的四大常见误读及纠正

items.nameZh: 「这次过境就是我的土星回归」
items.subEn: Only true if natal Saturn is in Aries — for everyone else it is an ordinary house transit, not the 29-year milestone
items.subZh: 仅对本命土星在白羊座的人成立——其他人只是普通的宫位过境，并非29年里程碑

items.nameEn: "Saturn in Aries Means Bad Luck for Aries People"
items.nameZh: 「牧羊座土星对白羊座人不利」
items.subEn: Aries sun-sign readers feel the first-house version, but this is structuring pressure on initiative, not a sentence
items.subZh: 白羊座太阳的人感受第一宫版本，但这是对行动力的结构性压力，而非惩罚

items.nameEn: "The Whole Period Is One Long Hardship"
items.subEn: Saturn moves through retrograde and direct phases — pressure pulses with distinct peaks, not flat through April 2028
items.subZh: 土星经历逆行和顺行阶段，压力有高峰期起伏，而非持续平压直至2028年4月

items.subEn: The method is identical for anyone — locate the Aries house, read its domain, ask what structure it lacks
items.subZh: 方法对所有人都相同——找到白羊座宫位，解读其领域，问缺少什么结构
